paragraphs.text: Days of anorexia/hyporexia (include days of anorexia/hyporexia at home) 5 days: Nutritional support is required! Place feeding tube or initiate parenteral nutrition. 3-4 days: Nutritional support likely needed if recovery is not imminent. Consider feeding tube placement if patient will be anesthetized. 1-2 days: Write feeding orders, monitor food intake and clinical condition daily. Note: If the patient is already malnourished, nutritional support should be instituted as soon as hemodynamically stable.
Create a feeding plan (ie, diet, route, amount, and frequency). Goal is to meet resting energy requirements (RER), although it may take 2-3 days to reach RER.

1. If able to eat, try voluntary oral feeding or coax feeding. Write specific feeding orders: “Feed 1/4 can Diet X orally q 6 hrs.” (diet, route, amount, frequency) 2. Monitor intake. If adequate intake is not achieved orally, assisted feeding techniques are needed:
